Index.meta_title: Marksheet: every test, graded on one card
Index.meta_description: Log what you tested, how it went and when. A sample product built on the Next.js + Spring Boilerplate.
Index.title: Every test, graded on one card.
Index.intro: Log what you tested, how it went and when. Marksheet keeps every mark in one place, so you can see what passed at a glance.
Index.remark: Strong term. Retake the Spanish listening part.
Index.key_title: Three marks, read in one look
Index.key_intro: Every result gets one mark. Scan down the column and you know where you stand.
Index.key_failed: A circle: it failed and wants another go.
Index.key_pending: An open box: still waiting on the result.
Index.rows_intro: Five fields, the same every time, so every row lines up with the last.
Index.row_name_desc: What you tested, in your own words. Up to 100 characters.
Index.row_score_desc: A mark from 0 to 100. Decimals are fine.
Index.row_tested_at_desc: When the test happened, to the minute.
Index.row_notes_desc: A remark for later. Optional, up to 1,000 characters.
Index.features_title: Kept the way a card should be
Index.feature_totals: Counts for each mark, updated the moment you add a row.
Index.feature_history: Every result you have logged, most recent test first, ten to a page.
Index.feature_private: Each account sees only its own results. Your session lives on the server, never in the browser's JavaScript.
Index.feature_languages: Switch language from any page and the card follows.
Index.close_text: Create an account, log your first test and watch the mark go on.

About.meta_description: About Marksheet and the template it is built on
About.title: About this template
About.about_paragraph: Marksheet is a sample product. It shows what a frontend built on the spring-postgres-boilerplate API looks like when it is finished: a landing page, sign-in, and an app working on real data.
About.replace_paragraph: To start your own product, replace the Marksheet copy in src/locales and swap the test-results example for your own domain.
About.feature_auth: Sign up, sign in and sign out with the backend's JWT and rotating refresh tokens, kept in httpOnly cookies
About.feature_api: A typed API client generated from the backend's OpenAPI spec
About.feature_ui: Shared UI components from shadcn/ui, themed with design tokens
About.feature_quality: Lint, type checks, unit tests and full-stack end-to-end tests in CI
About.credits: Based on <upstream>Next.js Boilerplate</upstream> by ixartz (MIT licence).

ChartsPage.bar_description: Commits per month over a year.

ChartsPage.simple_pointed_description: The same line with a dot on every value.
ChartsPage.simple_bar_description: Bars without axes, for tight spaces.

WidgetsPage.title: Widgets
WidgetsPage.description: Figure cards for dashboards. The template's Bootstrap colours map onto Marksheet: primary to folder, success to pass, info to ink, warning to slate and danger to pencil.
WidgetsPage.progress_description: A figure with a bar and a note, on card stock or filled with the tone.
WidgetsPage.progress_uptime_note: Two short outages, both on Sunday night.
WidgetsPage.progress_orders_note: A quarter of the yearly target so far.
WidgetsPage.progress_revenue_note: Up 4% on the same quarter last year.
WidgetsPage.progress_storage_note: Of the 8 TB in your plan.

WidgetsPage.brand_description: A logo band over two figures, first plain, then with a sparkline behind the logo.
WidgetsPage.progress_icon_description: An icon, a figure and a bar: joined in a card group, then as separate cards.
WidgetsPage.dropdown_description: A filled card with an options menu and a sparkline; hover the chart for values.
WidgetsPage.simple_description: A label, a figure and a small chart.

BreadcrumbsPage.title: Breadcrumbs
BreadcrumbsPage.description: Show where a page sits in the app and give a way back up.
BreadcrumbsPage.card_description: The last item is the current page; every other item is a link.
BreadcrumbsPage.links_title: App links and an external link

CardsPage.title: Cards
CardsPage.description: Panels for one subject of content. Marksheet tones stand in for the Bootstrap colours; red pen is kept for errors.
CardsPage.body: Term two results are in. Each subject shows its mark, the teacher’s remark and the date of the next test.
CardsPage.quote_text: A mark tells you where you are. A remark tells you where to go next.
CardsPage.quote_source: A form tutor, in <cite>The staff handbook</cite>

CarouselsPage.title: Carousels
CarouselsPage.description: Cycle through a few slides with arrows, indicators and autoplay.
CarouselsPage.card_description: Autoplay pauses while you point at or focus the slides. Use the arrow keys once a control has focus.
CarouselsPage.slide_first_text: Report cards for the spring term go home on Friday.
CarouselsPage.slide_blank_text: A placeholder slide, waiting for its picture.

CollapsesPage.title: Collapses
CollapsesPage.description: Show and hide content in place, with nested panels, a folding card and an accordion.
CollapsesPage.collapse_description: A button toggles a panel; a second button inside toggles a nested one.
CollapsesPage.contents: The collapsed content sits here until the button opens it.
CollapsesPage.card_text: Click the card header to fold the body away and again to bring it back. The header stays in place, so the page does not jump while you read the rest of the card. Teachers use this for long remarks: the mark stays visible and the remark opens on demand.
CollapsesPage.accordion_description: Only one section is open at a time; open one to close the others.
CollapsesPage.accordion_marks_text: Each test is scored out of 100. The term mark is the average of every test taken in the term.
CollapsesPage.accordion_remarks_text: The subject teacher writes a remark for each test; the form tutor adds one for the term.
CollapsesPage.accordion_retakes_title: Can a failed test be retaken?
CollapsesPage.accordion_retakes_text: Yes, once per term. The retake replaces the first mark, even when it is lower.

JumbotronsPage.title: Jumbotrons
JumbotronsPage.description: A large hero band for the one message a page has to get across.
JumbotronsPage.basic_lead: Test results, written up like a school report card.
JumbotronsPage.basic_text: Read how the app works on the about page.
JumbotronsPage.slots_description: A heading, a lead, a rule, a paragraph and actions.
JumbotronsPage.hero_lead: A simple hero unit that calls extra attention to featured content or information.
JumbotronsPage.hero_text: It uses the type scale and spacing tokens to lay the content out inside the band.
JumbotronsPage.colors_description: On a folder-green field, the way the marketing hero is drawn.

ListGroupsPage.title: List groups
ListGroupsPage.description: Ruled lists of rows: plain, active, disabled, links, buttons, badges, contextual tones and custom content.
ListGroupsPage.links_description: Rows that are links; the active one is the page you are on.
ListGroupsPage.buttons_description: Rows that are buttons; pressing one selects it.
ListGroupsPage.colors_description: Marksheet tones stand in for the Bootstrap colours.
ListGroupsPage.colors_links_description: The same tones on link rows, with a hover state.
ListGroupsPage.colors_default: This is a default list group item
ListGroupsPage.card_with_flush: Card with a flush list group
ListGroupsPage.card_text: Each subject keeps its tests in date order. Open one to see its marks, remarks and the date of the next test.
ListGroupsPage.days_ago: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
ListGroupsPage.custom_spanish_text: Listening went well; the written part needs another pass before the final.
ListGroupsPage.custom_physics_text: The method was clear and the measurements were careful. Show the units in every table.
ListGroupsPage.custom_disabled_text: This test was withdrawn and no longer counts towards the term mark.

NavbarsPage.title: Navbars
NavbarsPage.description: App bars with a brand, links, menus and a search form. Below their breakpoint they fold behind a menu button.
NavbarsPage.main_description: Folds below the medium breakpoint. User → Sign out really signs you out.
NavbarsPage.search_result: No results for “{query}” in this demo.

NavsPage.title: Navs
NavsPage.description: Navigation items as plain links, tabs or pills, in a row or a column. Press an item to make it current.
NavsPage.basic_description: The current item is printed in ink; the others are links.
NavsPage.fill_description: Items grow to fill the row and keep their own widths.
NavsPage.justified_description: Items share the row in equal widths.

PaginationsPage.title: Paginations
PaginationsPage.description: Move through pages of results. All six bars share one current page.

PopoversPage.title: Popovers
PopoversPage.description: A small panel of extra content, opened by clicking its button and closed with Escape or a click outside.
PopoversPage.placement_description: Each button opens its popover on a different side and alignment. Near a screen edge it flips to stay in view.

ProgressBarsPage.title: Progress bars
ProgressBarsPage.description: Show how far along something is: labels, widths, heights, tones, stripes and stacked bars.
ProgressBarsPage.counter_description: Both bars follow the same counter; the stacked one splits it 60 / 25 / 15.
ProgressBarsPage.counter_button: Click me to animate the progress bars
ProgressBarsPage.colors_description: Marksheet tones stand in for the Bootstrap colours. Values change every two seconds.
ProgressBarsPage.animated_description: The stripes stay still when your system asks for reduced motion.
ProgressBarsPage.multiple_description: Several segments stacked in one track.
ProgressBarsPage.multiple_mixed: Stacked bars, each styled on its own

SwitchesPage.title: Switches
SwitchesPage.description: On/off controls in every CoreUI style: filled, outline, opposite and 3D, with shapes, labels and sizes. Marksheet tones stand in for the Bootstrap colours.
SwitchesPage.radio_description: Only one can be on; the badge names the chosen tone.
SwitchesPage.default_description: The first switch drives the badge.

TabsPage.title: Tabs
TabsPage.description: Switch between panels in the same place: tab and pill styles, icons and a vertical list. Use the arrow keys to move between tabs.
TabsPage.panel_home: 1. The home tab sums up the term: tests taken, the average mark and what is due next. Everything else in the file is one tab away.
TabsPage.panel_profile: 2. The profile tab holds the student’s details: form group, tutor, and the contact used for report cards. Changes are saved as you type.
TabsPage.panel_disabled: 3. This tab is disabled, so its panel cannot be opened.
TabsPage.panel_calculator: 1. Work out a term average: add the marks of every test taken this term and divide by the number of tests.
TabsPage.panel_cart: 2. The shopping cart holds the revision guides ordered for the term. Pay at the school office before the last week of term.
TabsPage.panel_charts: 3. Charts show each subject’s marks over the year, so a slipping subject stands out before the report card goes home.
TabsPage.tabs_description: Underlined tabs; the third one is disabled.
TabsPage.pills_description: The same tabs in the pill style.
TabsPage.vertical_description: Pills stacked beside their panel; they sit above it on phones.

TooltipsPage.title: Tooltips
TooltipsPage.description: A short label shown on hover or keyboard focus, on buttons and links.
TooltipsPage.basic_description: The first opens on hover, focus and click; the second starts open.
TooltipsPage.link_sentence: Tooltips work on links too: <link>see your results</link>.
TooltipsPage.placement_description: Hover or focus each button to see its side and alignment.

AlertsPage.title: Alerts
AlertsPage.description: Short messages in the flow of the page: tones, links, longer content, dismissing and timers.
AlertsPage.tones_description: Marksheet tones stand in for the Bootstrap colors; red pen is kept for errors.
AlertsPage.links_description: Links inside an alert are bold and underlined in the alert's own color.
AlertsPage.tone_link: {tone} alert with <link>a link to the test results</link>.
AlertsPage.content_description: A title, paragraphs and a rule inside one alert.
AlertsPage.content_body: All marks for the spring term are in. This text runs a little longer so you can see how spacing works inside an alert with more than one paragraph.
AlertsPage.content_footer: Keep blocks inside an alert evenly spaced with the gap and margin utilities.
AlertsPage.dismissible_description: Close an alert with its icon or its own button, then bring both back.
AlertsPage.dismissible_custom_text: Dismissible alert with a custom button.
AlertsPage.auto_description: Both alerts share one countdown and close themselves when it reaches zero.
AlertsPage.countdown_bold: This alert closes in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}…
AlertsPage.countdown_plain: This alert closes in {count, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}…

BadgesPage.title: Badges
BadgesPage.description: Small tracked-caps tags beside headings, inside buttons and as links. Status is never a badge: it is a mark.
BadgesPage.headings_description: A badge scales with the heading it sits in.
BadgesPage.variants_description: The Marksheet variants stand in for the Bootstrap colors.
BadgesPage.pill_description: Add rounded-full for a pill shape.
BadgesPage.links_description: With asChild a badge renders as a link and gets a hover state.

BrandButtonsPage.title: Brand buttons
BrandButtonsPage.description: Buttons for other services: the brand's mark and name on an outline button.
BrandButtonsPage.brand_colors: Marksheet does not carry brand colors: the mark keeps the ink color of the button.

StandardButtonsPage.title: Buttons
StandardButtonsPage.description: Every button variant, size and state, as printed tabs on a white ply.
StandardButtonsPage.standard_description: Marksheet has no Bootstrap color set, so each row shows the button variants instead.
StandardButtonsPage.outline_description: Use variant="outline" for a bordered button on the white ply.
StandardButtonsPage.ghost_description: Use variant="ghost" for a text-only button that fills on hover.
StandardButtonsPage.icons_description: Icons sit before the label; icon-only buttons carry an accessible name.
StandardButtonsPage.toggle_description: All six toggles share one pressed state: press any of them.
StandardButtonsPage.block_description: Add w-full to fill the width of the container.

ColorsPage.title: Colors
ColorsPage.description: The Marksheet palette: folder green, card stock, the three marks and one navy ink ramp.
ColorsPage.theme_description: Each swatch is painted from its CSS token; the contrast is measured against the color it is read with.
ColorsPage.ink_description: The only neutrals: every grey in the app is a step of this navy ramp.
ColorsPage.role_folder: The report card's cover: sidebar, hero, primary button, focus ring and links.
ColorsPage.role_folder-deep: Inside the cover: footer band, primary hover, current nav item.
ColorsPage.role_folder-ink: Text and the inverse button on folder green.
ColorsPage.role_folder-ink-soft: Secondary text and resting nav items on folder green.
ColorsPage.role_pass: The passed tick, and nothing else.
ColorsPage.role_pen: Red pen: failed marks, errors and destructive actions only.
ColorsPage.role_paper: Desk card stock, the page background.
ColorsPage.role_paper-card: Card face: cards, dialogs and the paper surface.
ColorsPage.role_ply: White ply under every control and popover.

DropdownsPage.title: Button dropdowns
DropdownsPage.description: Menus opened from a button: dividers, headers, positions, sizes and split buttons.
DropdownsPage.positioning_description: Align the menu to either edge, open it upwards or nudge it with an offset.
DropdownsPage.caret_description: An icon trigger without a caret; its name is read out instead.
DropdownsPage.aria_description: Items are grouped under labelled headers so screen readers announce each group.
DropdownsPage.variants_description: Every button variant can open a menu.

ButtonGroupsPage.title: Button groups
ButtonGroupsPage.description: Buttons joined into one control, toolbars of groups, and toggle groups.
ButtonGroupsPage.basic_description: Inner corners square off and borders overlap; a few buttons drop out on small screens.
ButtonGroupsPage.dropdown_description: A dropdown, a nested submenu and a split dropdown inside one group.
ButtonGroupsPage.toolbar_description: Groups, inputs and menus side by side in a toolbar.
ButtonGroupsPage.toolbar_inputs_label: Toolbar with button groups and inputs
ButtonGroupsPage.toolbar_menu_label: Toolbar with button groups and a dropdown menu
ButtonGroupsPage.toggle_description: A group that keeps one choice, and one that keeps several.

CoreuiIconsPage.title: Icon library
CoreuiIconsPage.description: The Lucide set this app uses in place of the CoreUI free icons.
CoreuiIconsPage.gallery_description: Press an icon to copy the name you import from lucide-react.

BrandsPage.title: Brand icons
BrandsPage.description: The CoreUI brand set, for sign-in buttons and links to other services.
BrandsPage.gallery_description: Press an icon to copy its name.

FlagsPage.title: Flags
FlagsPage.description: The CoreUI flag set, named by ISO 3166-1 country code.
FlagsPage.gallery_description: Press a flag to copy its name.

ModalsPage.title: Modals
ModalsPage.description: Dialogs on the lifted paper: sizes, a scrolling body, contextual modals and a destructive confirmation.
ModalsPage.card_description: Every modal opens centered, traps focus and closes with Escape; the custom one ignores clicks outside.
ModalsPage.body: The marks for the spring term are ready to review. Check each result before you share the report card; changes stay a draft until you publish them.
ModalsPage.long_p1: Each test is marked out of 100. A score of 50 or more is a pass; anything below is marked with the red pen and needs a retake.
ModalsPage.long_p2: Pending results are boxed in pencil until the teacher records a score. They do not count towards the totals yet.
ModalsPage.long_p3: Notes are written by hand under the test name. Keep them short: what went well, and one thing to work on next.
ModalsPage.long_p4: Retakes keep the original result on the card and add a new row, so the history of each subject stays visible.
ModalsPage.long_p5: Before publishing, read the card from top to bottom once more. Families see it exactly as it is printed here.
ModalsPage.long_p6: Questions about a mark go to the subject teacher first, then to the head of year if they cannot be settled.
ModalsPage.success_description: Families can now see the spring term report.
ModalsPage.pending_description: Three tests still have no score.
ModalsPage.destructive_description: The Spanish mock exam result will be removed from the report card. This cannot be undone.
ModalsPage.custom_description: A custom header and footer; clicking outside does not close it.

ToasterPage.title: Toasts
ToasterPage.description: Short-lived messages that float over the page, plus a desktop notification from the browser.
ToasterPage.card_description: Set the options, then add as many toasts as you like; each position keeps its own count.
ToasterPage.form_title: Add a toast with these options
ToasterPage.toast_body_placeholder: Leave empty for a numbered message
ToasterPage.generated_body: This is toast number {number} in the “{position}” position.
ToasterPage.desktop_body: Spring term marks are ready to review.
ToasterPage.desktop_shown: Notification sent. Check your system tray if it did not pop up.
ToasterPage.desktop_denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser's site settings to try again.
ToasterPage.desktop_dismissed: No notification sent: the permission prompt was closed without a choice.
ToasterPage.desktop_unsupported: This browser cannot show desktop notifications from a web page.
ToasterPage.static_empty: No static toasts. Choose the static position and add one.

TypographyPage.title: Typography
TypographyPage.description: The Marksheet type scale: Libre Franklin for everything printed, Kalam for the hand that fills the form in.
TypographyPage.headings_description: Three heading roles cover the app and the marketing pages; tight, heavy and printed.
TypographyPage.sample_headline: Results you can read at a glance
TypographyPage.classes_description: Each role is a set of utility classes, so a p or span can look like a heading when the outline needs a different level.
TypographyPage.display_description: Heavier and larger, for the hero on folder green, the error pages and the totals.
TypographyPage.text_description: Lead, body and hint copy, the table text, the printed label and the two handwritten roles.
TypographyPage.text_sample_lead: Keep every test result in one place and see how each subject is going, term after term.
TypographyPage.text_sample_body: Each result has a test name, a status, a score out of 100 and the date it was taken. Notes are optional.
TypographyPage.text_sample_hint: Use the name printed on the test paper.
TypographyPage.text_sample_hand_remark: A strong term. Keep reading every day.
TypographyPage.inline_description: Styling for common inline HTML elements, kept within the ink ramp.
TypographyPage.inline_mark: Use the mark element to <mark>highlight</mark> text.
TypographyPage.inline_del: This line of text is meant to be treated as deleted text.
TypographyPage.inline_s: This line of text is meant to be treated as no longer accurate.
TypographyPage.inline_ins: This line of text is meant to be treated as an addition to the document.
TypographyPage.inline_u: This line of text will render as underlined.
TypographyPage.inline_small: This line of text is meant to be treated as fine print.
TypographyPage.inline_strong: This line is rendered as bold text.
TypographyPage.inline_em: This line is rendered as italic text.
TypographyPage.dl_description: Terms are printed labels; they sit beside the description from the small breakpoint. Long terms can use truncate.
TypographyPage.dl_lists: A description list is perfect for defining terms.
TypographyPage.dl_marking_1: Each test is marked out of 100; 50 or more is a pass.
TypographyPage.dl_marking_2: Pending results do not count towards the totals.
TypographyPage.dl_retakes: A retake adds a new row and keeps the first result on the card.
TypographyPage.dl_truncated: When a term is too long for its column, it is cut with an ellipsis and its full text shows on hover.
TypographyPage.dl_nested: A description list can sit inside another one.

AdvancedFormsPage.title: Advanced forms
AdvancedFormsPage.description: Masked inputs, searchable selects and date pickers.
AdvancedFormsPage.masked_description: Each field accepts only what fits its pattern.
AdvancedFormsPage.multiselect_description: Search and pick several options; remove a chip to drop it. One option is disabled.
AdvancedFormsPage.select_description: A searchable select for one value, and a clearable one for several.
AdvancedFormsPage.date_picker_description: Pick a range on the calendar, or open one from a field.

BasicFormsPage.title: Basic forms
BasicFormsPage.description: Every form control on its white ply: text, selects, checks, files, groups and validation states.
BasicFormsPage.credit_card_description: Payment details: name, number, expiry and security code.
BasicFormsPage.company_description: Billing address of the school or company.
BasicFormsPage.elements_description: Labels beside their controls, stacked on phones.
BasicFormsPage.full_name_hint: Let us know your full name.
BasicFormsPage.files_selected: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}
BasicFormsPage.inline_description: Fields on one line, each with its label in front.
BasicFormsPage.horizontal_description: Sign-in fields with their labels on the left.
BasicFormsPage.normal_description: Both fields are required and checked as you type.
BasicFormsPage.input_grid_description: Inputs sized on the 12-column grid from the sm breakpoint up.
BasicFormsPage.basic_validation_description: An optional field and a required one, validated from the start.
BasicFormsPage.custom_validation_description: A custom rule: at least 4 characters.
BasicFormsPage.icon_groups_description: Icons and text attached before or after the input.
BasicFormsPage.dropdown_groups_description: Action menus and a split button attached to the input.
BasicFormsPage.grid_large_description: Pairs split from the md breakpoint up and stack on phones. The buttons show the Marksheet variants.
BasicFormsPage.grid_small_description: Pairs keep their split at every width. The buttons show the Marksheet variants.
BasicFormsPage.example_text_description: Text in front, icon at the end.

CodeEditorsPage.title: Code editors
CodeEditorsPage.description: A code editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers and two themes.
CodeEditorsPage.card_description: Switch the language to load its sample; switch the theme to keep your edits.

TextEditorsPage.title: Text editors
TextEditorsPage.description: A rich text editor that writes clean HTML.
TextEditorsPage.card_description: Format with the toolbar or the usual shortcuts; the HTML updates as you type.
TextEditorsPage.article_intro: A report card is a document that tells a student and their family how the student is doing at school. It lists each subject with a mark, a short remark written by the teacher, and a total at the foot of the page.
TextEditorsPage.article_terms: Report cards go home at the end of each term. Many schools now publish them online as well as on paper, so families can read them on the day they are signed.
TextEditorsPage.article_quote_intro: A form tutor at a secondary school described the remark like this:
TextEditorsPage.article_quote: “A mark says where a student stands. The remark says what to do next, and that is the line a family reads twice.”
TextEditorsPage.article_layout: The layout has stayed close to the printed form: ruled rows, small capital labels and a signature line, so a card from today still reads like one from fifty years ago.

ValidationFormsPage.title: Validation forms
ValidationFormsPage.description: Model-based validation that checks each field as you type and the whole form on submit.
ValidationFormsPage.intro: <rhf>React Hook Form</rhf> with a <zod>zod</zod> schema gives simple, model-based validation; here it drives the Marksheet form fields.
ValidationFormsPage.accept_label: I accept the terms of use

SpinnersPage.title: Spinners
SpinnersPage.description: Loading indicators: the base spinners and the SpinKit set, drawn with CSS.

SpinnersPage.spinkit_text: Simple loading spinners animated with CSS. SpinKit animates only transform and opacity, which the browser can hardware-accelerate, so the loaders stay smooth and are easy to restyle.
